messages:
karen: Heads up — sample-app onboarding (Go) failed during smoke tests after regen. Panicking on enum unmarshalling. CI blocked for SDK release.

nate: omg, screenshot or logs?

karen: paste logs:

```log
panic: runtime error: index out of range [5] with length 5
goroutine 1 [running]:
main.someFunc()
  /workspace/sampleapp/main.go:42 +0x1a3
encoding/json: unknown enum value "INTERNAL_BETA"
```

ashley: that looks like enum value present in API but missing in generated Go const set — typegen probably reordered or pruned values.

typegen-bot: regendiff detected changes for openapi/models.yaml: enum ordering changed for schema 'DeploymentState' (old: [PENDING, RUNNING, STOPPED], new: [RUNNING, PENDING, STOPPED, INTERNAL_BETA])

samir: Wait — ordering change shouldn't drop a value. Did upstream spec add INTERNAL_BETA? or typegen bug?

karen: Spec didn't change. The only commit in the PR is bumping typegen tool to v1.14.0 — suspect non-deterministic enum sort in new generator.

jen: CI regendiff shows hash mismatch on go/typehash: `typehash: 0x7f1a -> 0x4b2c` and sdk-publish job failed with semver guard: "patch bump required" even though API surface changed.

nate: So we have a runtime breaking change caused by tooling, but semver label? This is a breaking behavioral change -> at least minor (new exported constant added/removed). We need to stop the release.

ashley: Agreed. Patch-only bump is not safe. Hold release. Revert the typegen bump in the release branch and open an investigation issue.

samir: Quick mitigation — add defensive unmarshal in Go client:

```go
func (s *DeploymentState) UnmarshalJSON(b []byte) error {
  var v string
  if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &v); err != nil { return err }
  switch v {
  case "PENDING", "RUNNING", "STOPPED": *s = DeploymentState(v)
  default: *s = DeploymentState("UNKNOWN")
  }
  return nil
}
```

karen: Can we hotfix the sdk publish with that wrapper and release a minor? Or safer to revert and re-run pipeline after locking typegen.

jen: Revert is faster and keeps guarantees. I'll open a revert PR: r=jen/revert-typegen-bump

devex-ci-bot: created revert PR #487, CI started — sdk-publish job queued.

nate: Also file a test in regendiff CI to assert stable enum ordering: add canonical sort by enum name in typegen and a golden-file test.

ashley: I'll own the test and a patch to the pipeline to fail on nondeterministic enum order in outputs. Also add a changelog entry template note for regen tooling changes.

samir: We should also update our release docs: regen tool bumps must be validated against sample-app smoke tests for each SDK.

karen: Thanks all. Plan: block release, revert, add tests, then re-evaluate typegen bump in a separate non-topline PR. :eyes:

nate: :thumbsup:

samir: filing issue for typegen v1.14 nondet-enum: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/issues/1122
